final: WITH rc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM rc WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM rc WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.cnt, rc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS ratio, rc.cnt - av.avg_cnt AS diff FROM rc CROSS JOIN tot CROSS JOIN av WHERE rc.cnt > av.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_kept_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_count_over_total, AVG(diff) AS avg_count_minus_avg FROM kept
